their_evidence: Avengers: Endgame: the 2014 Thanos transports his army, Cull included, to 2023 and summons the Black Order down from the Sanctuary II to the Compound ruins; Cull fights Steve, Korg, Drax and Tony for him and is stomped to death by Scott as Giant-Man. No dialogue between them; the stage rests on Cull acting for Thanos.

proposed.title: Avengers: Endgame

their_evidence: Avengers: Endgame, Sanctuary II in 2014: Thanos has Maw examine Nebula's glitching synaptic drive; Maw finds 'another Nebula' with a time stamp nine years in the future, plays her memories, then fashions a chain around Nebula's neck to execute her as a traitor until Thanos spares her. The app's single Nebula file covers both Nebulas.

question: The 2014 Gamora stands by as Maw searches Nebula's memories for Thanos and tries to execute her. Is sharing that small scene, both serving Thanos, enough for an Endgame stage between Maw and Gamora?

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Ebony Maw is one of the orphans Thanos takes from a conquered world and raises as his own child in the Black Order. He is his father's most devoted herald, preaching Thanos' mercy to the people he slaughters and hunting the Time Stone for him in New York.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Maw's adoptive father. Maw serves as his most devoted herald.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Adopted son and most devoted herald of Thanos. Hunts the Time Stone for him.

proposed.title: Avengers: Endgame
proposed.text: In 2014, Ebony Maw searches Nebula's memories for Thanos and shows him his own future. Maw follows his father to 2023, fights for him at the ruined Avengers Compound and turns to dust with him in Tony Stark's snap.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Maw's adoptive father. Maw uncovers his future for him and dies with him.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Adopted son who searches Nebula's memories for him. Turns to dust with him.

their_evidence: Endgame: the 2014 Maw examines the captured Nebula for Thanos ('Sire, the file appears entangled... another Nebula'), plays her memories of Thanos' future and death, then follows him to 2023, alerts him that Barton has the gauntlet, and is dusted by Stark's snap. These are the 2014 versions of both, as the app already does for the 2014 Gamora.

their_evidence: Vol. 3: Nebula had kept in contact with the 2014 Gamora (Quill asks why she didn't tell him); Gamora joins the Orgoscope and Counter-Earth missions with the Guardians; at the end Gamora rejoins the Ravagers and Nebula stays on Knowhere to raise the children.
